scope: Mocked EAS worker pages, CLI arguments, and in-process persistence fakes only; no provider or database access
checks: Explicit lookback reprocesses records older than the saved cursor but not older than the requested floor
Replayed records use the existing idempotent bounded page write
The saved cursor remains monotonic after replay
Negative CLI lookback and negative, boolean, or fractional direct-call values fail before database access
The isolated worker help exposes the manual recovery option without shared database configuration
The successful worker result reports the selected replay interval

scheduled_command_contract.check: Scheduled EAS commands still require exactly one chain and reject the manual replay option

limitations: The replay is opt-in and its requested interval is chosen by the operator; the zero-second default preserves current scheduled behavior
Records later discovered outside the requested interval are not automatically recovered
Concurrent offset-page stability, live provider behavior, and MAN-CAP acceptance remain open
